summary: Q₁ is diagonal with positive entries.

steps.claim: Q₁ is a diagonal matrix (LᴴL only touches the two z-entries); its entries are 1/2 at the X₀ indices and −N/2 + N⁻¹N² = N/2 > 0 at the two z indices; a real diagonal matrix with positive entries is positive definite.
steps.lean:
(by simp [linkMetric, middleGram, IsDiag, Pairwise] :
  S.linkMetric.IsDiag).diagonal_diag ▸ by simp [linkMetric, middleGram, map_ofNat, field, Ne.pos]
